Package com.anylogic.libraries.pypeline

Class Jsonifier

java.lang.Object
com.anylogic.engine.Presentable
com.anylogic.engine.Utilities
com.anylogic.engine.Agent
com.anylogic.libraries.pypeline.Jsonifier
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.anylogic.engine.AgentConstants, com.anylogic.engine.EnvironmentConstants, com.anylogic.engine.IMaintenanceable, com.anylogic.engine.internal.i, com.anylogic.engine.UtilitiesMath, com.anylogic.engine.UtilitiesRandom, com.anylogic.engine.UtilitiesString, Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
PyCommunicator
public class Jsonifier extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent
Add this custom object to your model to gain access to all the functions for serializing and deserializing objects in your model. For serialization of agents and populations (via the `toJson` functions), you can customize the filter, which defines what fields are/are not included, through the properties of the object.
Note that the filter is shared by all instances of the Jsonfiier object, so you only need one instance per model.

    boolean
    includeAutogeneratedsBL
    Whether the autogenerated objects will be initially included in the blacklist (i.e., omitted from any JSON outputs).
    Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter, or you can use the function inside the filter object.
    boolean
    includeAutogeneratedsWL
    Whether the autogenerated objects will be initially included in the whitelist (i.e., included in any JSON outputs).
    Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter, or you can use the function inside the filter object.
    Class<?>[]
    includedClassesBL
    The set of classes initially blocked being outputted to JSON.
    Class<?>[]
    includedClassesWL
    The set of classes allowed to be outputted to JSON.
    Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter.
    String[]
    includedNamesBL
    The initial set of object names, or regex patterns, for which any object whose name matches any one of these will be blocked from being outputted to JSON.
    String[]
    includedNamesWL
    The initial set of object names, or regex patterns, for which any object whose name matches any one of these will be allowed to be outputted to JSON.
    String[]
    includedPackagesBL
    The initial set of package names, for which any classes belonging to these will be blocked from being outputted to JSON.
    String[]
    includedPackagesWL
    The initial set of package names, for which any classes belonging to these will be allowed to be outputted to JSON.
    boolean
    isBlacklistMode
    Whether the filter is in blacklist mode (included objects are omitted from the output) or whitelist mode (only included objects will be in the output).
    Calling this parameter's `set_` function will apply the mode and then reset based on the included objects in the other parameters.
    boolean
    isCustomConfiguration
    Whether to start the filter with empty inclusions or filled with the sets of objects.

    <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent>
    T
    fromAgentJson(String json, Class<T> clazz)
    Converts a JSON string of parameter mapping to an active agent, initialized from the root level agent.
    This function will only work if called from the AnyLogic editor with the Jsonifier object created as an agent itself (i.e., not programmatically) or manually initialized by calling its `createAndStart` function.
    Example 1: Person p = fromAgentJson("{\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}", Person.class);
    Example 2: Person p = fromAgentJson("single_agent.json", Person.class);
    static <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent>
    T
    fromAgentJson(String json, Class<T> clazz, com.anylogic.engine.Agent anyAgent)
    Converts a JSON string of parameter mapping to an active/initialized agent.
    Example 1: Person p = fromAgentJson("{\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}", Person.class, this);
    Example 2: Person p = fromAgentJson("single_agent.json", Person.class, this);
    static <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent>
    T
    fromAgentJson(String json, Class<T> clazz, com.anylogic.engine.AgentArrayList population)
    Converts a JSON string of parameter mapping to an active/initialized agent
    The agent will be added to the specified population.
    Example 1: fromAgentJson("{\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}", Person.class, peoplePop);
    Example 2: fromAgentJson("single_agent.json", Person.class, peoplePop);
    static <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent>
    T
    fromAgentJson(String json, String pointer, Class<T> clazz, com.anylogic.engine.Agent anyAgent)
    Converts a JSON string of parameter mapping to an active/initialized agent.
    Example 1: Person p = fromAgentJson("{\"options\": [{\"age\": 21, \"name\": \"Paul\"}, {\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}]}", "/options/1", Person.class, this);
    Example 2: Person p = fromAgentJson("person_data.json", "/options/1", Person.class, this);
    static <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent>
    T
    fromAgentJson(String json, String pointer, Class<T> clazz, com.anylogic.engine.AgentArrayList population)
    Converts a JSON string of parameter mapping to an active/initialized agent
    The agent will be added to the specified population.
    Example 1: fromAgentJson("{\"options\": [{\"age\": 21, \"name\": \"Paul\"}, {\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}]}", "/options/1", Person.class, peoplePop);

    static <T> T
    fromJson(String json, Class<T> clazz)
    Converts a JSON string to a POJO (i.e., not an AnyLogic-based class - namely agent or agent population types)
    Example 1: List<Integer> nums = fromJson("[1, 2, 4, 8]", List.class);
    Example 2: List<Integer> nums = fromJson("input_list.json", List.class);
    static <T> T
    fromJson(String json, String pointer, Class<T> clazz)
    Converts a JSON string to a POJO (i.e., not an AnyLogic-based class - namely agent or agent population types)
    Example 1: List<Integer> nums = fromJson("{\"inputs\": {\"num_lists\": [ [0], [1, 2, 4, 8] ]}}", "/inputs/num_lists/1", List.class);
    Example 2: List<Integer> nums = fromJson("input_data.json", "/inputs/num_lists/1", List.class);
    static <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent>
    ArrayList
    fromPopulationJson(String json, Class<T> agent_clazz, com.anylogic.engine.Agent anyAgent)
    A function specifically for converting the given JSON (an array of objects mapping parameter names to value) to an arraylist of agents.
    Example 1: ArrayList<Person> pop = fromPopulationJson("[{\"age\": 21, \"name\": \"Paul\"}, {\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}]", Person.class, this);
    Example 2: ArrayList<Person> pop = fromPopulationJson("person_list.json", Person.class, this);
    static <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent>
    void
    fromPopulationJson(String json, Class<T> agent_clazz, com.anylogic.engine.AgentArrayList population)
    Converts a list of agents from JSON (specifically an array of objects mapping parameter names to value) and adds it to an existing population.
    Example 1: fromPopulationJson("[{\"age\": 21, \"name\": \"Paul\"}, {\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}]", Person.class, peoplePop);
    Example 2: fromPopulationJson("person_list.json", Person.class, peoplePop);

  • Field Details

    • isBlacklistMode

      public boolean isBlacklistMode
      Whether the filter is in blacklist mode (included objects are omitted from the output) or whitelist mode (only included objects will be in the output).
      Calling this parameter's `set_` function will apply the mode and then reset based on the included objects in the other parameters.

    • isCustomConfiguration

      public boolean isCustomConfiguration
      Whether to start the filter with empty inclusions or filled with the sets of objects. If empty, being in blacklist mode will try to output everything, while being in whitelist mode will block everything.
      Calling this function's `set_` function and with the custom option enabled (i.e., `true`) will use the values of the parameters; if the empty option is enabled (i.e., `false`) the autogenerated flag will use the blacklist's parameter value and the sets will be cleared.

    • includeAutogeneratedsBL

      public boolean includeAutogeneratedsBL
      Whether the autogenerated objects will be initially included in the blacklist (i.e., omitted from any JSON outputs).
      Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter, or you can use the function inside the filter object.
      An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in whitelist mode (use the other parameter).

    • includeAutogeneratedsWL

      public boolean includeAutogeneratedsWL
      Whether the autogenerated objects will be initially included in the whitelist (i.e., included in any JSON outputs).
      Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter, or you can use the function inside the filter object.
      An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in blacklist mode (use the other parameter).

    • includedPackagesBL

      public String[] includedPackagesBL
      The initial set of package names, for which any classes belonging to these will be blocked from being outputted to JSON.
      Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter with the new set. Individual objects can be added/removed using the functions in the filter object.
      An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in whitelist mode (use the other parameter).

    • includedPackagesWL

      public String[] includedPackagesWL
      The initial set of package names, for which any classes belonging to these will be allowed to be outputted to JSON.
      Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter with the new set. Individual objects can be added/removed using the functions in the filter object.
      An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in blacklist mode (use the other parameter).

    • includedClassesBL

      public Class<?>[] includedClassesBL
      The set of classes initially blocked being outputted to JSON.
      Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter. An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in whitelist mode (use the other parameter).

    • includedClassesWL

      public Class<?>[] includedClassesWL
      The set of classes allowed to be outputted to JSON.
      Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter. An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in blacklist mode (use the other parameter).

    • includedNamesBL

      public String[] includedNamesBL
      The initial set of object names, or regex patterns, for which any object whose name matches any one of these will be blocked from being outputted to JSON.
      Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter with the new set. Individual objects can be added/removed using the functions in the filter object.
      An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in whitelist mode (use the other parameter).

    • includedNamesWL

      public String[] includedNamesWL
      The initial set of object names, or regex patterns, for which any object whose name matches any one of these will be allowed to be outputted to JSON.
      Calling this function's `set_` function will update the filter with the new set. Individual objects can be added/removed using the functions in the filter object.
      An error will be thrown if trying to set this while in blacklist mode (use the other parameter).

      protected static com.anylogic.engine.Agent root

    • Jsonifier

      public Jsonifier(boolean isBlacklistMode, boolean loadDefaultConfig)
      Initialize the class in the specified mode with either empty or default inclusion configuration. Note that if empty, a blacklisted filter will allow everything through and a whitelisted filter will allow nothing.
      Parameters:
      isBlacklistMode - Whether the filters' references should be blocked from the output (blacklist/true) or should be the only references allowed (whitelist/false)
      loadDefaultConfig - Whether to load the default references for the provided mode or have the filter completely empty

      public static <T> T fromJson(String json, Class<T> clazz)
      Converts a JSON string to a POJO (i.e., not an AnyLogic-based class - namely agent or agent population types)
      Example 1: List<Integer> nums = fromJson("[1, 2, 4, 8]", List.class);
      Example 2: List<Integer> nums = fromJson("input_list.json", List.class);
      Parameters:
      json - A JSON string to be converted or a path to a file with this information
      clazz - The class - specifically a standard Java type - to convert the provided string to
      Returns:
      The object of the specified type (or `null` if errors were encountered)

    • fromPopulationJson

      public static <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent> ArrayList fromPopulationJson(String json, String pointer, Class<T> agent_clazz, com.anylogic.engine.Agent anyAgent)
      A function specifically for converting the given JSON (an array of objects mapping parameter names to value) to an arraylist of agents.
      Example 1: ArrayList<Person> pop = fromPopulationJson("{\"options\": [{\"age\": 21, \"name\": \"Paul\"}, {\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}]}", "/options", Person.class, this);
      Example 2: ArrayList<Person> pop = fromPopulationJson("person_data.json", "/options", Person.class, this);
      Parameters:
      json - A JSON string **or** a path to a file with this information
      pointer - A JSON pointer expression to identify the part of the string to convert; if null or empty, uses the json String directly
      agent_clazz - The class of the AL agent type
      anyAgent - Literally any other active agent in your model; used to properly start the agent (you can use `this` to refer to the active agent you're calling it from).
      Returns:
      ArrayList An ArrayList of the agents

    • fromAgentJson

      public static <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent> T fromAgentJson(String json, String pointer, Class<T> clazz, com.anylogic.engine.AgentArrayList population)
      Converts a JSON string of parameter mapping to an active/initialized agent
      The agent will be added to the specified population.
      Example 1: fromAgentJson("{\"options\": [{\"age\": 21, \"name\": \"Paul\"}, {\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}]}", "/options/1", Person.class, peoplePop);
      Example 2: fromAgentJson("person_data.json", "/options/1", Person.class, peoplePop);
      Parameters:
      json - A JSON string to be converted to an AL agent **or** a path to a file with this information
      pointer - A JSON pointer expression to identify the part of the string to convert; if null or empty, uses the json String directly
      clazz - The class of the AL agent type to convert the provided string to
      population - The population to add this agent to
      Returns:
      The agent of the specified type (or `null` if errors were encountered)

    • fromPopulationJson

      public static <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent> void fromPopulationJson(String json, String pointer, Class<T> agent_clazz, com.anylogic.engine.AgentArrayList population)
      Converts a list of agents from JSON (specifically an array of objects mapping parameter names to value) and adds it to an existing population.
      Example 1: fromPopulationJson("{\"options\": [{\"age\": 21, \"name\": \"Paul\"}, {\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}]}", "/options", Person.class, peoplePop);
      Example 2: fromPopulationJson("person_data.json", "/options", Person.class, peoplePop);
      Parameters:
      json - A valid JSON array **or** a path to a file with this information
      pointer - A JSON pointer expression to identify the part of the string to convert; if null or empty, uses the json String directly
      agent_clazz - The Java class for the agent type to convert to
      population - The population to add the agents to

    • fromAgentJson

      public <T extends com.anylogic.engine.Agent> T fromAgentJson(String json, Class<T> clazz)
      Converts a JSON string of parameter mapping to an active agent, initialized from the root level agent.
      This function will only work if called from the AnyLogic editor with the Jsonifier object created as an agent itself (i.e., not programmatically) or manually initialized by calling its `createAndStart` function.
      Example 1: Person p = fromAgentJson("{\"age\": 30, \"name\": \"Tyler\"}", Person.class);
      Example 2: Person p = fromAgentJson("single_agent.json", Person.class);
      Parameters:
      json - A JSON string to be converted to an AL agent **or** a path to a file with this information
      clazz - The class of the AL agent type to convert the provided string to
      Returns:
      The agent of the specified type (or `null` if errors were encountered)
